about: YouTube channels of top LoL players and streamers with first-person recordings (own client, own HUD, often webcam and stream overlays), plus spectator/broadcast channels for contrast.
method: candidates from YouTube search (yt-dlp ytsearch) and known streamers; handle probe https://www.youtube.com/@<handle>?hl=en (200 = exists, metadata from ytInitialData); last 30 uploads and 15 live VODs listed with yt-dlp --flat-playlist; up to 3 recent long videos (>=10 min) inspected with yt-dlp -J --skip-download for resolution/date; webcam, overlay and HUD judged by eye from YouTube storyboard frames (no video downloaded)

fields.region: game server of the recorded games (KR/CN/VN/EUW/NA/JP/TR), null if unknown
fields.content_type: full_game_pov | stream_vod | edited_pov | commentary_pov | highlights | guide | spectator | broadcast
fields.hud: standard | cn_client (Chinese Tencent client) | custom_minimap_left | spectator | broadcast
fields.resolution: most common best video format among inspected recent long videos
fields.last_long_upload: upload date of the newest inspected long video
fields.typical_minutes: median duration of the listed uploads on source_tab
fields.source_tab: where the useful long recordings are: videos or streams (Live) tab
fields.dataset_fit: yes = full games with little editing; partial = usable after filtering (long VODs, mixed content, stale); no = clips, guides, spectator or broadcast

caveats: Video/subscriber counts are YouTube's rounded display values as of the collection date.
Webcam/overlay/HUD were judged from a few storyboard frames per channel; streamers move their webcam, and re-upload channels mix several streamers with different layouts.
HUD scale and minimap size were not measured: every channel needs a layout check before frames go into the dataset.
Stream re-uploads by third parties may be taken down; check that the video is still available before harvesting.
The KR pro archives take games from SOOP streams: webcams and sponsor logos sit in the bottom-right corner, sometimes over the minimap.
